_note: Verbatim excerpt of components.schemas from the official BTCPay Greenfield swagger, used only to check that this repo's test fixtures and request bodies conform to the documented shapes. It is NOT a recording of a real server.

BOLT11.description: The BOLT11 of the invoice to pay

amount.description: Optional explicit payment amount in millisatoshi (if specified, it overrides the BOLT11 amount)

maxFeePercent.description: The fee limit expressed as a percentage of the payment amount

maxFeeFlat.description: The fee limit expressed as a fixed amount in satoshi

sendTimeout.description: The number of seconds after which the payment times out

BOLT11.description: The BOLT11 representation of the payment

preimage.description: The payment preimage (available when status is complete)

createdAt.description: The unix timestamp when the payment got created

totalAmount.description: The total amount (including fees) in millisatoshi

nodeURIs.description: Node URIs to connect to this node in the form `pubkey@endpoint[:port]`

blockHeight.description: The block height of the lightning node

alias.description: The alias of the lightning node

color.description: The color attribute of the lightning node

version.description: The version name of the lightning node

id.description: The ID of the API Key, used to revoke it without sending the secret

apiKey.description: The API Key to use for API Key Authentication

label.description: The label given by the user to this API Key

created.description: Timestamp when the API Key was created. (null if created before 2.4.4)

permissions.description: The permissions associated to this API Key (can be scoped to a specific store)

ProblemDetails.description: Description of an error happening during processing of the request

code.description: An error code describing the error

message.description: User friendly error message about the error

ValidationProblemDetails.description: An array of validation errors of the request

items.description: A specific validation error on a json property

path.description: The json path of the property which failed validation

message.description: User friendly error message about the validation

BOLT11.description: The BOLT11 representation of the invoice

paidAt.description: The unix timestamp when the invoice got paid

expiresAt.description: The unix timestamp when the invoice expires

amount.description: The amount of the invoice in millisatoshi

preimage.description: The payment preimage (available when status is complete)

customRecords.description: The custom TLV records attached to a keysend payment

amount.description: Amount wrapped in a string, represented in a millisatoshi string. (1000 millisatoshi = 1 satoshi)

description.description: Description of the invoice in the BOLT11

descriptionHashOnly.description: If `descriptionHashOnly` is `true` (default is `false`), then the BOLT11 returned contains a hash of the `description`, rather than the `description`, itself. This allows for much longer descriptions, but they must be communicated via some other mechanism.

privateRouteHints.description: True if the invoice should include private route hints

post.description: Pay a lightning invoice. In case the payment response times out, the status will be reported as pending and the final status can be resolved using the [Get payment](#operation/StoreLightningNodeApi_GetPayment) endpoint. The default wait time for payment responses is 30 seconds — it might take longer if multiple routes are tried or a hold invoice is getting paid.

responses.503: Unable to access the lightning node
responses.404: The lightning node configuration was not found

get.description: View information about the requested lightning payment

responses.503: Unable to access the lightning node
responses.404: The lightning node configuration or the specified invoice was not found
